title: State Service State
description: Maintains a configurable key–value store and expands macro templates against incoming data. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/state)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

macros.description: Named macros. Each macro has variables (keys to substitute) and a template (object or array of objects with $value placeholders)
